question_en: Is there a fee-adjusted Polymarket edge?
question_zh: Polymarket 上有没有扣完费的优势？
sub_en: 718 markets scanned. 0 raw “edges.” 0 survived fees and a full exclusive set.
sub_zh: 扫了 718 个市场。生结果 0 条边。扣费并核完整分区后是 0。

fee.note_en: Use each market’s feeSchedule.rate when feesEnabled. Never assume 0.
fee.note_zh: feesEnabled 时用该市场 feeSchedule.rate，不默认 0。

fed.cme_source: Investing Fed rate monitor / ZQV26 96.105 (Altınla bins broken post-FOMC)
fed.note_en: October watch. PM exclusive +25bp mid 0.505 vs CME-method hike-bin 0.574 (gap 6.9pp) — mismatch_flag false (≥~8–10pp). Buying the whole NegRisk set costs 1.0539 after 5% fees — no edge. September FOMC resolved +25bp; prior mismatch retired.
fed.note_zh: 十月观察。PM 独家 +25bp mid 0.505 对 CME 方法加息档 0.574（缺口 6.9 个百分点）——错配标记 false（≥约 8–10pp）。整组 NegRisk 扣 5% 费后成本 1.0539，无边。九月 FOMC 已公布 +25bp，先前错配已退役。
fed.recheck_en: Re-check if: (1) contracts are definition-matched, AND (2) NegRisk net cost/share < 1 after live feeSchedule, AND (3) the expensive legs still have size, OR |PM−CME gap| ≥ ~8–10pp on matched bins.
fed.recheck_zh: 重检条件：定义对齐，且 NegRisk 扣现费后净成本 < 1，且贵的那几条仍有深度；或对齐档上 |PM−CME| 缺口 ≥ 约 8–10 个百分点。

receipt.title: Bank of Japan Decision in September?
receipt.reason_en: Best NegRisk near-miss this scan (net_cps 1.0033). No raw clear edges; after audit still 0. Tiny gap over $1 after 5% fees — not a clean fee-adjusted edge.
receipt.reason_zh: 本轮最佳 NegRisk 近失（净成本 1.0033）。生结果无清晰边；审计后仍为 0。扣 5% 费后略高于 $1——不是干净的扣费后优势。
receipt.recheck_en: Re-check if sum(ask)+fees < 1 with displayed size on every exclusive leg, and the partition is exhaustive vs the event market count.
receipt.recheck_zh: 重检条件：互斥组相对事件市场数穷尽、每条有深度，且 ask+费 < 1。

scan.near_miss_filter_en: Raw near-misses are Yes+No (or exclusive-set) net within a few cents of $1. Most are longshot dust. Watch list keeps incomplete partitions and the live Fed book.
scan.near_miss_filter_zh: 原始近失是 Yes+No（或互斥组）扣费后净成本离 $1 只差几分。多数是长尾尘埃。观察名单只留分区不完整、以及在轨的美联储盘。
scan.count_rule_en: 718 = 708 Yes/No books + 10 NegRisk events. Full set in universe.json.
scan.count_rule_zh: 718 = 708 个 Yes/No 盘 + 10 个 NegRisk 事件。全集在 universe.json。

fomc.note_en: Public pre-print freezes 14–16 Sep (last 2026-09-16-1637). Official +25bp. Countable freeze-vs-print starts here. Mismatch watch retired post-print.
fomc.note_zh: 9/14–16 公开事前冻结（末次 2026-09-16-1637）。官方 +25bp。可计分冻盘对公布从此开始。错配观察在公布后退役。

method.en: Audit, not a teaser. Scan exclusive NegRisk Yes-asks; reject any incomplete partition; apply that market’s feeSchedule.rate (fee = C × rate × p × (1−p); rebate ignored). A Fed gap counts only if contracts are definition-matched. Scorecards freeze T−2h modal Yes mid vs BLS first print. Engine stays private; every number on this page is in desk.json.
method.zh: 这是审计，不是预告页。扫互斥 NegRisk 的 Yes 卖一；分区不完整就否；用该市场 feeSchedule.rate（fee = C × rate × p × (1−p)，忽略返佣）。利率缺口只在定义对齐时才算。记分卡用 T−2h 众数 Yes mid 对 BLS 首次。引擎不公开；这页每个数都在 desk.json。

history_policy.en: A freeze is pre-print only if the GitHub commit time is before the official release. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep freezes were internal; first public copy is the 14 Sep 10:20 snapshot (commit c32856a). Later snapshots on 14–16 Sep are additional public pre-print freezes for FOMC 15–16 Sep. After the FOMC print (+25bp), this publish appends a result snapshot without rewriting freeze files. Countable freeze-vs-print starts at FOMC 15–16 Sep.
history_policy.zh: 只有 GitHub commit 时间早于官方公布，冻盘才算事前。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 的冻结当时只在内部；第一次公开是 9/14 10:20 快照（commit c32856a）。9/14–16 的后续快照是 9/15–16 FOMC 的追加事前公开冻结。FOMC 公布（+25bp）后，本次只追加结果快照，不改写冻结文件。可计分的冻盘对公布从 9/15–16 FOMC 开始。

notify.en: No push alerts. Poll desk.json. If verdict or scan.after_audit changes, the conclusion changed. GitHub commits are the publish log.
notify.zh: 没有推送。轮询 desk.json。verdict 或 scan.after_audit 变了就是结论变了。GitHub commit 是发布记录。
